instruction: Add a new habit tracking log note for today in my Simple Note account. It should be the same as yesterday, except I had a good posture today.
notes: Single-app task (simple_note). Current date is given (2023-05-18) so yesterday is 2023-05-17 and no phone date lookup is needed. The agent must log in, find yesterday's habit tracking log via search_notes, read its full details (title, content, tags, pinned) with show_note, then create a new note whose title/header is for today, whose YAML habit entries equal yesterday's except 'had a good posture' is marked done, with the same tags and pinned status. The problem encodes today's title/content as objects statically 'derived' from yesterday's note; create_note requires yesterday's details to have been read first. The goal uses a nullary flag (habit-log-added-for-today) that is only reachable by creating the correctly derived note, so supervisor-complete-task (no answer, task is not a question) can check it directly. Exactly one note must be added and no existing notes updated or deleted, which the model enforces by only offering create_note.

plan: (simple-note-create-note title-today content-today simple-note-token habit-tags pinned-as-yesterday today-habit-log yesterday-habit-log)
